mode.title: Mode
mode.description: latest = one row per rate with change and range context. history = one row per published observation.

series.title: Rates
series.description: Which rates to return. Leave empty for all current ones. Choices: MORTGAGE30US, MORTGAGE15US, DPRIME, DFF, TERMCBCCALLNS, TERMCBAUTO48NS, RIFLPBCIANM60NM, TERMCBPER24NS, plus the discontinued MORTGAGE5US and MMNRNJ.

includeDiscontinued.title: Include discontinued rates
includeDiscontinued.description: Two series are no longer published but still return their final value. They are excluded by default; when included they are always marked isStale.

percentileYears.title: Context window (years)
percentileYears.description: How far back to look when working out the low, high, median and percentile rank for each rate.

historyFrom.title: History from
historyFrom.description: History mode only. Earliest observation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty means from the start of the series.

historyTo.title: History to
historyTo.description: History mode only. Latest observation date, YYYY-MM-DD.
